input: Draft a personal essay for a grad school application

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Personal Essay for Grad School
gold.taskDescription: Write a compelling personal essay tailored to a graduate school application.

questions.title: Which specific graduate program are you applying to?
questions.description: Identify the exact field or degree program (e.g., MBA, Clinical Psychology, Computer Science) to tailor the essay's focus.

questions.title: Which schools are you submitting this essay to?
questions.description: Know the target institutions to align the essay with their values, culture, and stated mission.

questions.title: What is the exact prompt or word limit given?
questions.description: Obtain the official essay prompt and any length constraints so the draft meets stated requirements.

questions.title: What specific experience most shaped your decision to apply?
questions.description: Identify the central story or turning point the essay should be built around for authenticity and impact.

questions.title: What are your stated career goals after the program?
questions.description: Understand the post-graduation vision so the essay connects past experience to a clear future direction.

questions.title: Do you have a draft or notes already started?
questions.description: Determine whether to build on existing material or start from scratch.

questions.title: What is your application submission deadline?
questions.description: Establish the timeline to prioritize drafting, revision, and finalization steps accordingly.
